evidence.quote: Concerns intensified after the Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia is in talks to provide $250 billion in financing to OpenAI as part of a data center project in Ohio. According to Jefferies, investors view the proposed arrangement as a prominent example of "circular financing," in which financing provided by a supplier ultimately helps generate demand for its own products.
evidence.one_line: 截至2026年7月28日，媒体报道称Nvidia正洽谈为OpenAI俄亥俄州数据中心项目提供2500亿美元融资；Jefferies称投资者将拟议安排视为供应商融资促成自身产品需求的“循环融资”案例。
evidence.speaker: Shir Reiter，Ctech记者；安排消息归因于《华尔街日报》，投资者观点归因于Jefferies
evidence.original_who: 《华尔街日报》（洽谈消息）；Jefferies（投资者观点）
